title: Python for Everybody Specialization

title: Intermediate Python Course

title: Python Decorators, Generators, and Context Managers
description: Deep dive into advanced Python concepts like decorators, generators, and custom context managers.

title: Command-Line Contact Manager in Python
description: Build a functional command-line contact manager application in Python, utilizing standard libraries.

title: SQL for Data Science
description: Learn the fundamentals of SQL to extract, clean, and analyze data from databases.

title: SQL Joins and Subqueries
description: Master joining multiple tables, writing complex subqueries, and aggregating dataset relationships.

title: Guide to SQL Window Functions

title: Financial Modeling and Pivot Tables Dashboard

description: Compare mean/median imputation, KNN, and MICE techniques for missing value imputation in large datasets.

title: Kaggle Pandas Micro-Course

title: Optimizing Pandas Memory Usage and Execution Speed
description: Learn how to optimize memory usage and speed up data manipulation operations using vectorized methods.

title: Statistical Inference and Regression Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and basic linear regression models.

title: Linear Algebra - MIT 18.06
description: A foundational course in linear algebra. Covers matrix factorization, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and singular value decomposition.

title: The Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for PCA

title: Linear Algebra Concept Assessment

title: Calculus 1

title: Multivariable Calculus and Vector Fields

title: Multivariable Calculus - MIT 18.02
description: Covers vector and multi-variable calculus, including partial derivatives, multiple integrals, line integrals, and Stokes' theorem.

title: Machine Learning Specialization

title: Mathematics of Gradient Descent Optimization Algorithms
description: Mathematical analysis of gradient descent, Adam, RMSprop, and learning rate schedules.

title: End-to-End Housing Price Prediction Model
description: Build a complete pipeline to predict housing prices, from data cleaning and scaling to random forest ensembles.

title: Supervised Learning and Model Evaluation Exam
description: Assess your knowledge of regression, classification, cross-validation, and ROC curves.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
description: Learn the foundations of deep learning, structure neural networks, and lead machine learning projects.

title: Neural Networks and Backpropagation from Scratch
description: A deep mathematical explanation of how neural networks learn, utilizing multivariable calculus.

title: Image Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks
description: Build and train a CNN to classify images from the CIFAR-10 dataset using PyTorch.

title: Building a Transformer Translation Model
